subject: DI01000081

body.en:
Understand the idea

Topology studies how circuit elements connect,independent of their numerical values or the physical drawing shape.

Explanation and application

  • A node joins connected ideal conductors at one potential.An essential node joins at least3branches;two crossing wires are connected only when the schematic indicates a junction.
  • Here a branch means one defined two-terminal element between nodes.A path is a connected sequence;an open path need not return to its start.
  • A loop is a closed path without repeatedly visiting intermediate nodes.A mesh contains no other loop inside it in the chosen planar drawing;not every loop is a mesh.
  • A connected graph tree spans all nodes without a loop;its branches are twigs and omitted branches are links.For Nnodes and Bbranches:twigs=N−1;independent loops/links=B−N+1.
Is every loop a mesh?

No.A mesh has no smaller loop inside in the planar graph.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Topologyમાં elements કેવી રીતે જોડાય છે તે અભ્યાસ થાય છે;તેમની numerical value અથવા drawingના આકારથી તે નક્કી થતું નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Connected ideal conductorsનો same-potential ભાગ node છે.Essential nodeમાં ઓછામાં ઓછી3branches મળે છે.Crossing wiresને junction દર્શાવેલું હોય ત્યારે જ connected માનો.
  • અહીં branchનો અર્થ બે nodes વચ્ચેનું એક defined two-terminal element છે.Path connected sequence છે;open path શરૂઆત સુધી પાછો આવવો જરૂરી નથી.
  • Loop intermediate nodes repeat કર્યા વગરનો closed path છે.Planar drawingમાં અંદર બીજો loop ન ધરાવતો loop mesh છે;દરેક loop mesh નથી.
  • Connected graphનું tree બધા nodesને loop વગર જોડે છે.Tree branches twigs અને બાકીની links કહેવાય છે.Nnodes,Bbranches માટે twigs=N−1 અને independent loops/links=B−N+1.
દરેક Loop Mesh છે?

ના.Planar graphમાં meshની અંદર નાનો loop નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

For the drawn connected graph,N=4nodes and B=6defined branches.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Twigs=N−1=4−1=3
  2. Links/independent loops=B−N+1=6−4+1=3

Interpretation and check

The formula assumes one connected graph and consistent branch definition.A different valid tree gives the same counts.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

દોરેલા connected graphમાં N=4nodes અને B=6defined branches છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Twigs=N−1=4−1=3
  2. Links/independent loops=B−N+1=6−4+1=3

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

સૂત્ર one connected graph તથા consistent branch definition માટે છે.અન્ય valid tree પસંદ કરતાં counts same રહે છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

In a linear network,the response voltage/current is the algebraic sum of responses from each independent source acting alone,with other independent sources deactivated.

How to apply it

  1. Choose the required branch voltage/current and fix its reference sign throughout.
  2. Keep one independent source active.Replace other ideal voltage sources by shorts and ideal current sources by opens.
  3. Keep source internal resistances and all dependent sources;deactivation is a model operation,not live wiring.
  4. Solve the selected response in that subcircuit,including a negative sign if it opposes the reference.
  5. Repeat for every independent source and sum the signed responses.
  6. Calculate power only after summing the actual voltage/current;check the complete network with KCL/KVL.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Applies to linear networks.Power does not superpose because P contains products/squares.Do not switch off dependent sources.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Linear networkમાં response voltage/current દરેક independent source એકલો કાર્ય કરે ત્યારે મળતા responsesનો algebraic sum છે;બીજા independent sources deactivate થાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Required branch voltage/current પસંદ કરીને આખા ઉકેલમાં reference sign same રાખો.
  2. એક independent source active રાખો.બીજા ideal voltage sourcesને short અને ideal current sourcesને openથી replace કરો.
  3. Source internal resistances તથા બધા dependent sources રાખો.Deactivation model operation છે,live wiring નથી.
  4. તે subcircuitમાં response solve કરો;referenceની વિરુદ્ધ હોય તો negative sign રાખો.
  5. દરેક independent source માટે repeat કરીને signed responses add કરો.
  6. Actual voltage/current add કર્યા પછી જ power ગણો;complete networkને KCL/KVLથી check કરો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Linear networks માટે લાગુ પડે છે.Powerમાં products/squares હોવાથી power superpose થતું નથી.Dependent sources બંધ ન કરો.

h.en: Two-source superposition with a power check

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Use the drawn circuit:12V through6ohm and6V through3ohm feed node V;6ohm load connects V to0V.Both sources have positive tops.

Step-by-step solution

  1. 12V alone:deactivate6V source to a short.The other paths from V to0V are3ohm||6ohm=2ohm,so V1=12×2/(6+2)=3V.
  2. 6V alone:deactivate12V source.The other paths are6ohm||6ohm=3ohm,so V2=6×3/(3+3)=3V.
  3. V=V1+V2=6V;IL=6/6=1A
  4. PL=V²/R=36/6=6W;separate-load powers=3²/6+3²/6=3W,NOT6W

Interpretation and check

Full-network check:(V−12)/6+(V−6)/3+V/6=0 gives V=6V.Power must use the combined response.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Drawn circuitમાં12Vથી6ohm તથા6Vથી3ohm મારફતે node V feed થાય છે;Vથી0V સુધી6ohm load છે.Both sourcesના tops positive છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. ફક્ત12V active રાખતાં6V source short થાય છે.Vથી0Vના3ohm||6ohm=2ohm થાય છે;તેથી V1=12×2/(6+2)=3V.
  2. ફક્ત6V active રાખતાં12V source short થાય છે.Other paths6ohm||6ohm=3ohm છે;તેથી V2=6×3/(3+3)=3V.
  3. V=V1+V2=6V;IL=6/6=1A
  4. PL=V²/R=36/6=6W;separate-load powers=3²/6+3²/6=3W,NOT6W

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Full-network checkમાં (V−12)/6+(V−6)/3+V/6=0થી V=6V મળે છે.Power માટે combined response જ લો.

h.en: Thevenin theorem and a safe analysis workflow

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

A linear two-terminal network can be replaced at a chosen port by Vth in series with Rth for the resistive DC model when that equivalent is well-defined.

How to apply it

  1. Choose and label load terminals a,b;remove only the load RL from the model.
  2. Find the open-circuit terminal voltage with original sources active:Vth=Voc,with the stated polarity.
  3. Find Rth looking into a,b:deactivate independent sources and retain their resistances.
  4. If dependent sources exist,retain them and use an appropriate test source:Rth=Vtest/Itest with a consistent input reference.
  5. Reconnect RL to the equivalent and compute IL=Vth/(Rth+RL),VL=ILRL.
  6. Check port polarity,units,and result against the original network;do not treat open-circuit voltage as loaded voltage.

Validity and common mistakes

  • The load may be nonlinear but then solve it with the linear source equivalent rather than blindly using a fixed RL formula.Not every active network has positive Rth.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Resistive DC modelમાં well-defined equivalent મળે ત્યારે chosen port પરથી linear two-terminal networkને series Vth અને Rthથી replace કરી શકાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Load terminals a,b ઓળખો અને modelમાંથી ફક્ત load RL દૂર કરો.
  2. Original sources active રાખીને open-circuit voltage શોધો:stated polarity મુજબ Vth=Voc.
  3. a,bની અંદર જોતાં Rth શોધો;independent sources deactivate કરો અને તેમની resistances રાખો.
  4. Dependent sources હોય તો રાખો અને suitable test sourceથી consistent input reference મુજબ Rth=Vtest/Itest શોધો.
  5. Equivalentમાં RL પાછો જોડીને IL=Vth/(Rth+RL),VL=ILRL ગણો.
  6. Port polarity,units અને original network સામે result check કરો;Vocને loaded voltage ન માનો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Load nonlinear હોય તો linear source equivalent સાથે તેનું યોગ્ય equation solve કરો;fixed RL formula અંધપણે નહિ.દરેક active networkમાં Rth positive જ હોય એવું નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

12V across4ohm and8ohm in series.Load terminals span8ohm;RL=16/3ohm connects across those terminals.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Vth=12×8/(4+8)=8V
  2. Rth=4||8=32/12=8/3ohm
  3. IL=8/[(8/3)+(16/3)]=1A;VL=16/3V

Interpretation and check

Removing RL does not remove the original8ohm divider arm.This distinction determines both Vth and Rth.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

12V ઉપર4ohm અને8ohm series છે.Load terminals8ohmની બન્ને બાજુ છે;ત્યાં RL=16/3ohm જોડાય છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Vth=12×8/(4+8)=8V
  2. Rth=4||8=32/12=8/3ohm
  3. IL=8/[(8/3)+(16/3)]=1A;VL=16/3V

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

RL દૂર કરતાં original8ohm divider arm દૂર થતો નથી.Vth તથા Rth માટે આ ભેદ મહત્વનો છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

The same linear port can be represented by IN in parallel with RN;RN=Rth and IN=Vth/Rth when finite and defined.

How to apply it

  1. Identify the same load port and reference direction as the original circuit.
  2. Find RN by the Thevenin resistance method,retaining dependent sources.
  3. Find IN from a valid Vth/Rth transformation or analyse the theoretical short-circuit port current in the circuit model.
  4. Place IN and RN in parallel with the correct source arrow feeding the positive terminal.
  5. Reconnect RL.Use IL=IN RN/(RN+RL) and VL=ILRL for a positive resistive load.
  6. Cross-check Norton and Thevenin terminal results;internal element powers of equivalents need not match the original network.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Never interpret short-circuit current as permission to short a battery or supply.Use supervised current-limited educational setups or analysis/simulation.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Same linear portને parallel IN તથા RNથી દર્શાવી શકાય છે.Finite અને defined હોય ત્યારે RN=Rth તથા IN=Vth/Rth.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Original circuitના same load port અને reference direction લો.
  2. Dependent sources રાખીને Thevenin resistance methodથી RN શોધો.
  3. Valid Vth/Rth transformationથી IN મેળવો અથવા circuit modelમાં theoretical short-circuit port current solve કરો.
  4. Positive terminalને feed કરે તેવી source arrow સાથે IN અને RN parallel મૂકો.
  5. RL જોડો અને positive resistive load માટે IL=IN RN/(RN+RL),VL=ILRL લો.
  6. Norton તથા Theveninના terminal results compare કરો;equivalentની internal powers original જેવી હોવી જરૂરી નથી.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Short-circuit currentનો અર્થ battery/supplyને short કરવાની પરવાનગી નથી.Supervised current-limited setup અથવા analysis/simulation વાપરો.

h.en: Norton check of the same divider

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Use Vth=8V,RN=8/3ohm and RL=16/3ohm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. IN=8/(8/3)=3A
  2. IL=3×(8/3)/[(8/3)+(16/3)]=1A
  3. VL=1×16/3=16/3V

Interpretation and check

Matches the Thevenin result;3A is a model source current,not a prescribed physical short test.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Vth=8V,RN=8/3ohm,RL=16/3ohm લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. IN=8/(8/3)=3A
  2. IL=3×(8/3)/[(8/3)+(16/3)]=1A
  3. VL=1×16/3=16/3V

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Thevenin result મળે છે.3A model source current છે,physical short testની સૂચના નથી.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

For a fixed resistive DC Thevenin source with Rth>0,the load power is maximum at RL=Rth.

How to apply it

  1. Find the source-side Vth and positive Rth seen by the adjustable load.
  2. IL=Vth/(Rth+RL);PL=IL²RL=Vth²RL/(Rth+RL)²
  3. Differentiating with respect to RL gives a stationary point at RL=Rth;power rises then falls for positive RL.
  4. PL,max=Vth²/(4Rth);IL,match=Vth/(2Rth)
  5. At matching,the internal Rth and RL dissipate equal power;the simple equivalent-source efficiency is50%.
  6. Apply voltage,current and thermal ratings before any practical load change;the theorem alone does not select safe components.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Maximum power is not maximum efficiency.Power-distribution systems normally avoid wasting half their equivalent input in source resistance.This formula does not cover arbitrary negative-R active sources.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Fixed resistive DC Thevenin sourceમાં Rth>0 હોય ત્યારે RL=Rth પર load power maximum મળે છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Adjustable load પરથી source-side Vth અને positive Rth શોધો.
  2. IL=Vth/(Rth+RL);PL=IL²RL=Vth²RL/(Rth+RL)²
  3. RL પ્રમાણે differentiate કરતાં RL=Rth મળે છે.Positive RL માટે power પહેલાં વધે અને પછી ઘટે છે.
  4. PL,max=Vth²/(4Rth);IL,match=Vth/(2Rth)
  5. Matching પર internal Rth અને RLમાં equal power dissipate થાય છે;simple equivalent-source efficiency50% છે.
  6. Practical load બદલતાં પહેલાં voltage,current,thermal ratings ચકાસો;ફક્ત theoremથી safe components પસંદ થતા નથી.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Maximum power અને maximum efficiency સમાન નથી.Power distributionમાં અડધી equivalent input source Rમાં વેડફવી ઇચ્છિત નથી.Arbitrary negative-R active source માટે આ formula નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Vth=12V,Rth=6ohm;compare RL=3,6,12ohm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. RL=3ohm:PL=144×3/9²=16/3W≈5.333W
  2. RL=6ohm:PL=144×6/12²=6W
  3. RL=12ohm:PL=144×12/18²=16/3W≈5.333W

Interpretation and check

Maximum6W occurs at6ohm;efficiency increases as RL grows,but absolute load power eventually falls.

Is maximum load power maximum source efficiency?

No.Positive-Rth matching gives50%in the simple source equivalent.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Vth=12V,Rth=6ohm;RL=3,6,12ohm compare કરો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. RL=3ohm:PL=144×3/9²=16/3W≈5.333W
  2. RL=6ohm:PL=144×6/12²=6W
  3. RL=12ohm:PL=144×12/18²=16/3W≈5.333W

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Maximum6W,6ohm પર મળે છે.RL વધતાં efficiency વધે છે,પણ અંતે absolute load power ઘટે છે.

Maximum Load Power એટલે Maximum Efficiency?

ના.Simple positive-Rth equivalentમાં matching પર50%થાય છે.

body.en:
Aim

Compare a measured total branch response with signed individual-source responses in an approved linear network.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.
  • Independent sources approved for the intended interaction;simulation is preferred when bench sources cannot safely absorb reverse current.

Connections and terminal roles

Use the labelled two-source circuit or a supervisor-approved equivalent.Deactivation is designed into the isolated setup,not performed by shorting an energised supply.

Supervised procedure

  1. Confirm network linearity,source roles and one fixed branch-current/voltage reference.
  2. Calculate expected total and each subcircuit response before any connection.
  3. Measure the total response with all sources active under approved conditions.
  4. Isolate every source before applying the approved inactive-source equivalent;retain internal resistances.
  5. Repeat for each source using the same measurement reference,then isolate the setup.
  6. Compare algebraic response sum with measured total;compute power only from combined response.

Observation table — blank

Trialtotal V/Asource1 response V/Asource2 response V/Asigned sumresidual
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Agreement within uncertainty supports the linear model over the tested conditions.Separate source powers must not be added as the load power.

Fault finding

  • Mismatch:check polarity,inactive-source modelling,dependent sources,source regulation and nonlinearity.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Approved linear networkમાં actual total branch responseને signed individual-source responses સાથે compare કરો.

Instruments અને પસંદગી

  • Intact leads,fuse તથા correct V/ohm/current socketsવાળું DMM લો.Manual limitsમાં expected value કરતાં યોગ્ય મોટી range પસંદ કરો.
  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.
  • Sourcesની interaction મંજૂર હોવી જોઈએ.Bench source reverse current safely absorb ન કરે તો simulation વધુ યોગ્ય છે.

Connections અને Terminals

Labelled two-source circuit અથવા approved equivalent લો.Deactivation isolated setupમાં design મુજબ થાય છે,energised supply short કરીને નહિ.

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. Linearity,source roles તથા એક fixed branch reference નક્કી કરો.
  2. Connection પહેલાં total તથા individual subcircuit responses ગણો.
  3. Approved conditionsમાં બધા sources active રાખીને total response માપો.
  4. Approved inactive-source equivalent ગોઠવતાં પહેલાં બધા sources isolate કરો.Internal R રાખો.
  5. Same referenceથી દરેક source માટે repeat કરીને setup isolate કરો.
  6. Algebraic sumને measured total સાથે compare કરો.Power combined response પરથી જ ગણો.

Observation Table — ખાલી

Trialtotal V/Asource1 response V/Asource2 response V/Asigned sumresidual
——————
——————
——————

ફક્ત actual readings,units,instrument range તથા uncertainty નોંધો.Notesનાં computed examples observations નથી.

Calculation અને Conclusion

Uncertaintyમાં agreement tested conditionsના linear modelને support કરે છે.Individual-source powersને load power તરીકે add ન કરો.

ખામીની તપાસ

  • Mismatchમાં polarity,inactive-source model,dependent sources,regulation,nonlinearity તપાસો.

સલામતી

Supervisionમાં approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment વાપરો.Connections/range/socket બદલતાં power OFF રાખો.Current-mode meter source ઉપર parallel ન મૂકો.

body.en:
Aim

Compare original-network load response with its source equivalent.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.

Connections and terminal roles

Choose the load port only.Remove RL from the isolated model/approved setup;do not remove an original internal resistor that happens to share the port.

Supervised procedure

  1. Label a,b,load and voltage/current references.
  2. Predict Vth,Rth and loaded response analytically.
  3. Measure original loaded V/I using authorised meter connections.
  4. With approved isolation/reconnection,measure open-circuit port voltage.Do not place an ohmmeter across an active circuit.
  5. Find Rth by the analytical deactivated-source/test-source method or an approved de-energised resistance method where applicable.
  6. Compare predicted/equivalent loaded response with actual readings and document source/meter limits.

Observation table — blank

RL ohmVoc VRth ohmpredicted IL Ameasured IL Ameasured VL V
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Use IL=Vth/(Rth+RL).For each branch requested by the assigned problem,use the relevant original circuit/equivalent port,not one port equivalent for all internal currents.

Fault finding

  • Wrong Rth:check which resistor is the load and whether independent/dependent sources were handled correctly.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Original networkના load responseને source equivalent સાથે compare કરો.

Instruments અને પસંદગી

  • Intact leads,fuse તથા correct V/ohm/current socketsવાળું DMM લો.Manual limitsમાં expected value કરતાં યોગ્ય મોટી range પસંદ કરો.
  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.

Connections અને Terminals

ફક્ત load port ઓળખો.Isolated model/approved setupમાંથી RL દૂર કરો;port પર રહેલો original internal R નહિ.

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. a,b,load તથા references label કરો.
  2. Vth,Rth તથા loaded response analytically ગણો.
  3. Authorised connectionsથી original loaded V/I માપો.
  4. Approved isolation/reconnectionથી open-circuit voltage માપો.Active circuit ઉપર ohmmeter ન મૂકો.
  5. Analytical deactivated-source/test-source અથવા applicable approved de-energised methodથી Rth મેળવો.
  6. Predicted/equivalent loaded responseને actual readings સાથે compare કરીને limits લખો.

Observation Table — ખાલી

RL ohmVoc VRth ohmpredicted IL Ameasured IL Ameasured VL V
——————
——————
——————

ફક્ત actual readings,units,instrument range તથા uncertainty નોંધો.Notesનાં computed examples observations નથી.

Calculation અને Conclusion

IL=Vth/(Rth+RL) લો.Assigned problemની internal branches માટે relevant original circuit/port વાપરો;એક equivalentથી બધા internal currents સીધા મળતા નથી.

ખામીની તપાસ

  • Wrong Rthમાં load resistorની ઓળખ તથા source handling તપાસો.

સલામતી

Supervisionમાં approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment વાપરો.Connections/range/socket બદલતાં power OFF રાખો.Current-mode meter source ઉપર parallel ન મૂકો.

Aim

Establish RN and IN without an uncontrolled supply short,then compare load results.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.

Connections and terminal roles

Use the same port as the Thevenin exercise.Find IN=Vth/Rth when valid;physical short-current measurement is not required by this guide.

Supervised procedure

  1. Draw the original network and Norton port with references.
  2. Find RN using the valid source-deactivation/test-source method.
  3. Determine IN analytically or by a specifically approved protected trainer,not by shorting a free supply.
  4. Calculate original/equivalent load voltage/current for the assigned load.
  5. Collect actual approved load measurements,isolating before all reconnections.
  6. Compare Thevenin,Norton and measured results at the same port.

Observation table — blank

RN ohmanalytical IN ARL ohmpredicted IL Ameasured IL Ameasured VL V
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

For two positive resistive branches,IL=IN RN/(RN+RL).Keep analytical IN clearly separate from measured data.

Fault finding

  • Arrow/sign mismatch:recheck terminal polarity and direction before comparing magnitudes.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.

body.en:
Aim

Measure load power over a safe range and compare the peak location with positive source resistance.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.
  • Adjustable resistive load rated for worst-case power;changing it requires isolation unless a purpose-built trainer permits otherwise.

Connections and terminal roles

Use a fixed approved source with known series resistance;measure the load voltage/current,not total input power as load power.

Supervised procedure

  1. Find Vth,Rth and expected safe power range.
  2. Select load settings below,near and above Rth within all ratings.
  3. Build de-energised and verify meter/load ratings.
  4. Collect actual VL,IL for each approved setting with isolation between changes.
  5. Compute PL=VLIL and plot PL versus measured RL.
  6. Compare observed peak with Rth,noting discrete steps,tolerance and heating.

Observation table — blank

RL ohmVL VIL APL Wsetting/rating note
—————
—————
—————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Matching maximises load power,not efficiency.Do not claim an exact peak from a few noisy data points.

Fault finding

  • Apparent shifted peak:check source drift,actual R,load heating and whether measured power belongs to RL only.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Safe rangeમાં load power માપીને peak locationને positive source R સામે compare કરો.

Instruments અને પસંદગી

  • Intact leads,fuse તથા correct V/ohm/current socketsવાળું DMM લો.Manual limitsમાં expected value કરતાં યોગ્ય મોટી range પસંદ કરો.
  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.
  • Worst-case power માટે rated adjustable load લો.Purpose-built trainer સિવાય load change પહેલાં isolation જરૂરી છે.

Connections અને Terminals

Known series Rવાળો fixed approved source લો.Load V/I માપો;total input powerને load power ન માનો.

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. Vth,Rth તથા expected safe power range શોધો.
  2. Ratingsની અંદર Rthથી નીચે,નજીક અને ઉપરનાં load settings પસંદ કરો.
  3. De-energised build કરીને meter/load ratings verify કરો.
  4. દરેક change વચ્ચે isolation રાખીને actual VL,IL લો.
  5. PL=VLIL ગણી measured RL સામે plot કરો.
  6. Observed peakને Rth સાથે compare કરીને step size,tolerance,heating નોંધો.

Observation Table — ખાલી

RL ohmVL VIL APL Wsetting/rating note
—————
—————
—————

ફક્ત actual readings,units,instrument range તથા uncertainty નોંધો.Notesનાં computed examples observations નથી.

Calculation અને Conclusion

Matching maximum power આપે છે,maximum efficiency નહિ.ઓછા noisy points પરથી exact peak claim ન કરો.

ખામીની તપાસ

  • Shifted peakમાં source drift,actual R,heating તથા RL-only power તપાસો.

સલામતી

Supervisionમાં approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment વાપરો.Connections/range/socket બદલતાં power OFF રાખો.Current-mode meter source ઉપર parallel ન મૂકો.

Aim

Compare a measured total branch response with signed individual-source responses in an approved linear network.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.
  • Independent sources approved for the intended interaction;simulation is preferred when bench sources cannot safely absorb reverse current.

Connections and terminal roles

Use the labelled two-source circuit or a supervisor-approved equivalent.Deactivation is designed into the isolated setup,not performed by shorting an energised supply.

Supervised procedure

  1. Confirm network linearity,source roles and one fixed branch-current/voltage reference.
  2. Calculate expected total and each subcircuit response before any connection.
  3. Measure the total response with all sources active under approved conditions.
  4. Isolate every source before applying the approved inactive-source equivalent;retain internal resistances.
  5. Repeat for each source using the same measurement reference,then isolate the setup.
  6. Compare algebraic response sum with measured total;compute power only from combined response.

Observation table — blank

Trialtotal V/Asource1 response V/Asource2 response V/Asigned sumresidual
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Agreement within uncertainty supports the linear model over the tested conditions.Separate source powers must not be added as the load power.

Fault finding

  • Mismatch:check polarity,inactive-source modelling,dependent sources,source regulation and nonlinearity.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Approved linear networkમાં actual total branch responseને signed individual-source responses સાથે compare કરો.

Instruments અને પસંદગી

  • Intact leads,fuse તથા correct V/ohm/current socketsવાળું DMM લો.Manual limitsમાં expected value કરતાં યોગ્ય મોટી range પસંદ કરો.
  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.
  • Sourcesની interaction મંજૂર હોવી જોઈએ.Bench source reverse current safely absorb ન કરે તો simulation વધુ યોગ્ય છે.

Connections અને Terminals

Labelled two-source circuit અથવા approved equivalent લો.Deactivation isolated setupમાં design મુજબ થાય છે,energised supply short કરીને નહિ.

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. Linearity,source roles તથા એક fixed branch reference નક્કી કરો.
  2. Connection પહેલાં total તથા individual subcircuit responses ગણો.
  3. Approved conditionsમાં બધા sources active રાખીને total response માપો.
  4. Approved inactive-source equivalent ગોઠવતાં પહેલાં બધા sources isolate કરો.Internal R રાખો.
  5. Same referenceથી દરેક source માટે repeat કરીને setup isolate કરો.
  6. Algebraic sumને measured total સાથે compare કરો.Power combined response પરથી જ ગણો.

Observation Table — ખાલી

Trialtotal V/Asource1 response V/Asource2 response V/Asigned sumresidual
——————
——————
——————

ફક્ત actual readings,units,instrument range તથા uncertainty નોંધો.Notesનાં computed examples observations નથી.

Calculation અને Conclusion

Uncertaintyમાં agreement tested conditionsના linear modelને support કરે છે.Individual-source powersને load power તરીકે add ન કરો.

ખામીની તપાસ

  • Mismatchમાં polarity,inactive-source model,dependent sources,regulation,nonlinearity તપાસો.

સલામતી

Supervisionમાં approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment વાપરો.Connections/range/socket બદલતાં power OFF રાખો.Current-mode meter source ઉપર parallel ન મૂકો.

body.en:
Aim

Compare a measured total branch response with signed individual-source responses in an approved linear network.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.
  • Independent sources approved for the intended interaction;simulation is preferred when bench sources cannot safely absorb reverse current.

Connections and terminal roles

Use the labelled two-source circuit or a supervisor-approved equivalent.Deactivation is designed into the isolated setup,not performed by shorting an energised supply.

Supervised procedure

  1. Confirm network linearity,source roles and one fixed branch-current/voltage reference.
  2. Calculate expected total and each subcircuit response before any connection.
  3. Measure the total response with all sources active under approved conditions.
  4. Isolate every source before applying the approved inactive-source equivalent;retain internal resistances.
  5. Repeat for each source using the same measurement reference,then isolate the setup.
  6. Compare algebraic response sum with measured total;compute power only from combined response.

Observation table — blank

Trialtotal V/Asource1 response V/Asource2 response V/Asigned sumresidual
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Agreement within uncertainty supports the linear model over the tested conditions.Separate source powers must not be added as the load power.

Fault finding

  • Mismatch:check polarity,inactive-source modelling,dependent sources,source regulation and nonlinearity.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.

Aim

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.

Supervised procedure

  1. Draw the original network and Norton port with references.
  2. Find RN using the valid source-deactivation/test-source method.
  3. Determine IN analytically or by a specifically approved protected trainer,not by shorting a free supply.
  4. Calculate original/equivalent load voltage/current for the assigned load.
  5. Collect actual approved load measurements,isolating before all reconnections.
  6. Compare Thevenin,Norton and measured results at the same port.
